answer: To limit Sybil attacks, an agent market can require every new identity to earn a credential through a randomly assigned, independently checked data audit. One verifies a tundra weather reading, another validates meadow soil samples, and another checks a beacon maintenance log. Auditors cross-check signed source records; fabricated evidence causes loss of a per-identity bond. A fraudster operating hundreds of identities must fund hundreds of bonds and supply hundreds of distinct, verifiable audits.
